postal_system.assignment_rule: The current UPU General Addressing Issues publication lists Belize among countries not requiring postal codes, and the UPU Belize addressing sheet edition 05/2021 shows no postcode in its official example. Current Belize Postal Service regular-mail and P.O.-Box instructions likewise publish no postcode requirement or assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No current postcode assignment exists to anchor a postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon. Districts, cayes, cities, towns, villages, localities, post offices, delivery areas, routes, P.O. Boxes, addresses, buildings, parcels, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi or raster cells, models and AGID cells remain independently typed and must not be relabelled as postal geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, street or P.O. Box, locality and country separately. Do not insert a synthetic ZIP/postcode, treat a P.O. Box number as a code, or expand a locality or box into an area.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store P.O. Boxes, offices, routes, services and delivery objects independently. A P.O. Box number is a private mailing object and is neither a postcode nor a postal-area identifier.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Preserve ISO BZ and all six district identities, cayes, cities, towns and villages. Administrative, settlement and postal-service identities are distinct layers and must not be merged or borrowed as postal assignments.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a separately rights-cleared civic-address identity and an explicit reviewed relation to permitted point or footprint geometry. A P.O. Box, district, caye, locality, office, route, parcel, coordinate or synthetic code is not an address-to-building relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Models and realtime services may validate a separately authorized address, box or service location only under source-specific rights. They must return no-current-postcode or independently typed context for BZ, never manufacture a postcode or postal surface, and preserve source, version, observation time, request digest, confidence and derived status.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Separately authorized BZ administrative, settlement, address, route, office or building evidence may be indexed only in its own authority class and never becomes a postcode or canonical postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: UPU website information may be referenced subject to acknowledgement, copyright and database conditions; those terms do not grant bulk postcode assignment or geometry rights. The reviewed Belize Postal Service pages publish service instructions but no resource-specific licence for a complete postcode assignment or geometry dataset. Compatible AGID processing, derivation, redistribution and public-serving rights were not established.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, customers, P.O. Box holders, delivery observations, exact addresses, coordinates, buildings, parcels, owners, occupants, query logs and land-right information require independent authority, purpose limitation, minimisation, retention and publication review. None is bundled.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The no-current-postcode finding is time-dependent. Store retrieval time, exact editions, bytes and SHA-256 and re-check after the pending-country sweep or when Belize Postal Service or UPU announces an actual postcode release. A future code proposal never upgrades itself to a current assignment release.

stages.definition: Belize generic address-format inventory and source links only.
Digest-bound current Belize Postal Service and UPU no-postcode evidence plus rights, identity, privacy and no-proxy contracts.

M2 requires a current dated Belize Postal Service or other competent-authority release putting postcodes into force and publishing a complete finite denominator of every assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit non-area object for ISO BZ, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Current Belize Postal Service and UPU evidence publishes no postcode requirement or postcode-bearing address example, while the UPU September 2025 table explicitly lists Belize among countries not requiring postal codes; P.O. Box numbers and address elements are typed mailing objects and never valid postcode inputs. Absence is represented as none and does not itself satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon visualization milestone. If postcodes enter into force, every drawable code must reconcile to a fixed real finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon whose postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, reproducible method, confidence and exceptions are explicit. Districts, cayes, cities, towns, villages, localities, offices, routes, service areas, delivery points, P.O. Boxes, addresses, buildings, parcels, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, models and AGID cells are prohibited proxies. P.O. Box, route, organization, office, Point and other non-area objects must expose their type and reason without a fabricated surface and remain M2-unmet while no eligible postal Polygon/MultiPolygon exists. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real BZ API/app, which handles no-code/no-match, loading, multiple, API-failure and invalid-geometry states, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline only for eligible real geometry, supports clear/re-search, and displays the selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: BZ metadata and no-current-postcode policy only; no real BZ Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future in-force authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignment and geometry artifacts and actual BZ loader/API/app verification are required before enablement.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a BZ postal polygon. Independently licensed administrative, settlement, route, office, address, parcel or building geometry stays typed and source-qualified and never inherits postal authority.
